title: Text-to-floor-plan: a Markdown-like DSL that renders scaled SVG/PDF blueprints
user: DIYers, renters, small landlords and engineers who want a scaled 2D floor plan or simple blueprint by typing wall/door/window coordinates, not by fighting CAD UIs
job_to_be_done: Produce a clean, dimensioned SVG/PDF from diff-able text.
smallest_useful_product: Static split-pane editor with units, scale, walls, doors, windows, labels and dimensions; live SVG; true-scale SVG/PDF and PNG exports; URL-hash and file sharing.
constraints: Dimension and print scale must be correct
